  <!-- Favicon — utilise l'icône de l'une de tes apps -->
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/webp;base64,">

  <!-- Polices -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Press+Start+2P&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>/* ================================================================
   VARIABLES
   ================================================================ */
:root {
  /* Polices */
  --f-main: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --f-pixel: 'Press Start 2P', monospace;

  /* Couleurs Academic Planner */
  --ap-500: #2563EB;
  --ap-600: #1D4ED8;
  --ap-700: #1E3A8A;
  --ap-300: #93C5FD;
  --ap-bg: #07111f;
  --ap-glow: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22);

  /* Couleurs Pixel Adventure */
  --pa-500: #3B6FE4;
  --pa-600: #1E40AF;
  --pa-gold: #F59E0B;
  --pa-green: #22C55E;
  --pa-purple: #7C3AED;
  --pa-bg: #050912;
  --pa-glow: rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.28);

  /* Site global */
  --bg: #07090f;
  --bg-2: #0c1220;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --gray-100: #F1F5F9;
  --gray-300: #CBD5E1;
  --gray-500: #64748B;
  --support: #E11D48;
  --itch: #FA5C5C;

  /* Layout */
  --max-w: 1160px;
  --r: 14px;
  --r-lg: 22px;
  --r-xl: 32px;

  /* Transitions */
  --t: 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* ================================================================
   RESET
   ================================================================ */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body {
  font-family: var(--f-main);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: inherit; color: inherit; }

/* ================================================================
   LAYOUT UTILITAIRE
   ================================================================ */
.container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--max-w);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 20px;
}

/* ================================================================
   NAVIGATION
   ================================================================ */
.header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 200;
  transition: background var(--t), backdrop-filter var(--t), box-shadow var(--t);
}

.header.solid {
  background: rgba(7, 9, 15, 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}

.nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 62px;
}

.nav-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--white);
}

.nav-brand-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ap-500);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nav-menu {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.nav-link {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--gray-300);
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: color var(--t), background var(--t);
}

.nav-link:hover { color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

.nav-link--cta {
  background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.12);
  color: #FDA4AF;
  border: 1px solid rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.25);
}

.nav-link--cta:hover {
  background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2);
  color: var(--white);
}

/* Hamburger */
.nav-toggle {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: background var(--t);
}

.nav-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); }

.nav-toggle span {
  display: block;
  width: 22px; height: 2px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: transform var(--t), opacity var(--t);
}

.nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px); }
.nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
.nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px); }

/* ================================================================
   BOUTONS
   ================================================================ */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 13px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  font-family: var(--f-main);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t), filter var(--t);
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-height: 50px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
}

.btn img { border-radius: 6px; object-fit: cover; flex-shrink: 0; }

.btn:active { transform: scale(0.97) !important; }

.btn-ap {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ap-500) 0%, var(--ap-600) 100%);
  color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35);
}
.btn-ap:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5); filter: brightness(1.08); }

.btn-pa {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pa-500) 0%, var(--pa-600) 100%);
  color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.35);
}
.btn-pa:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.5); filter: brightness(1.08); }

.btn-support {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--support) 0%, #BE123C 100%);
  color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.3);
}
.btn-support:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.5); filter: brightness(1.08); }

.btn-itch {
  background: rgba(250, 92, 92, 0.15);
  color: #FCA5A5;
  border: 1px solid rgba(250, 92, 92, 0.3);
}
.btn-itch:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(250, 92, 92, 0.22); color: var(--white); }

.btn-large {
  padding: 16px 32px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  min-height: 58px;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
}

/* ================================================================
   HERO
   ================================================================ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100svh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #060b18 0%, #0b1634 40%, #06111e 70%, #050912 100%);
  padding-top: 62px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* étoiles / particules — générées en JS */
.hero-stars {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden;
}

.star {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  animation: twinkle var(--dur, 3s) ease-in-out infinite;
  animation-delay: var(--delay, 0s);
}

@keyframes twinkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(1.3); }
}

.hero-layout {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 80px;
}

.hero-eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.hero-eyebrow span { color: var(--ap-300); }

.hero-heading {
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero-heading em {
  font-style: normal;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ap-300) 0%, var(--ap-500) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.hero-body {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--gray-300);
  max-width: 460px;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.hero-body strong { color: var(--white); font-weight: 600; }

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* Visuels flottants */
.hero-visuals {
  position: relative;
  height: 480px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.hero-card {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.hero-card--ap {
  width: 210px; height: 380px;
  left: 8%; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-5deg);
  border: 2px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  animation: floatAP 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.hero-card--pa {
  width: 290px; height: 180px;
  right: 2%; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(3deg);
  border: 2px solid rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.25), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  animation: floatPA 7s ease-in-out 3.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes floatAP {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-5deg); }
  50%       { transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 14px)) rotate(-5deg); }
}
@keyframes floatPA {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(3deg); }
  50%       { transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 14px)) rotate(3deg); }
}

/* dégradé de fondu vers la section suivante */
.section-fade {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 120px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--ap-bg));
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ================================================================
   SECTION ACADEMIC PLANNER
   ================================================================ */
.ap-section {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #07111f 0%, #0d1e42 35%, #0f265a 60%, #0d1e42 100%);
  padding: 80px 0 100px;
  position: relative;
}

/* En-tête d'app commune */
.app-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.app-header-icon {
  width: 72px; height: 72px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  object-fit: cover;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
}

.app-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.ap-tag {
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18);
  color: var(--ap-300);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
}

.pa-tag {
  background: rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.18);
  color: #93C5FD;
  border: 1px solid rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.35);
}

.app-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4.5vw, 2.9rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}

.ap-title {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #93C5FD 0%, var(--ap-500) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.pa-title {
  font-family: var(--f-pixel);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.6rem);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #93C5FD 0%, var(--pa-500) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.app-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.pa-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--f-pixel);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  color: var(--pa-500);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.app-desc {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--gray-300);
  max-width: 680px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin-bottom: 52px;
}

.pa-desc { color: #8BA5C8; }

/* ================================================================
   GRILLE DE FONCTIONNALITÉS
   ================================================================ */
.features {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 56px;
}

.feat {
  padding: 22px 20px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t), border-color var(--t);
}

.ap-feat {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
}
.ap-feat:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.38);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14);
}

.pa-feat {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025);
  border: 1px solid rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.18);
}
.pa-feat:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.18);
}

.feat-icon { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.feat-title {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}

.pa-feat-title {
  font-family: var(--f-pixel);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: #93C5FD;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.feat-body { font-size: 0.87rem; color: var(--gray-500); line-height: 1.7; }

/* ================================================================
   GALERIE — PORTRAITS (Academic Planner)
   ================================================================ */
.gallery-heading {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.ap-gallery-heading { color: var(--ap-300); }
.pa-gallery-heading {
  font-family: var(--f-pixel);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: #93C5FD;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.gallery { display: flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 48px; }

.phone-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  transition: transform var(--t);
}
.phone-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02); }

.phone-frame {
  width: 185px; height: 350px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  background: #000;
}

.ap-phone-frame {
  border: 2px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

/* pseudo-encoche */
.phone-frame::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 52px; height: 6px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.phone-frame img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.phone-card:hover .phone-frame img { transform: scale(1.04); transition: transform var(--t); }

.phone-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* ================================================================
   GALERIE — PAYSAGE (Pixel Adventure)
   ================================================================ */
.game-gallery {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  max-width: 680px;
}

.game-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  background: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  transition: transform var(--t);
}
.game-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); }

.game-frame {
  border-radius: var(--r);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 2px solid rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.22), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  background: #000;
}

.game-frame img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform var(--t); }
.game-card:hover .game-frame img { transform: scale(1.03); }

.game-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #60A5FA; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; }

/* ================================================================
   SECTION PIXEL ADVENTURE
   ================================================================ */
.pa-section {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #040a14 0%, var(--pa-bg) 30%, #060d1c 100%);
  padding: 80px 0 100px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pa-glow {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 5%, rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.18) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 60%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 70%, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.07) 0%, transparent 50%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Image splash en haut de la section PA */
.pa-splash-btn {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 52px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 72px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.3), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  border: 1px solid rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.25);
  transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t);
}
.pa-splash-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(59, 111, 228, 0.4); }

.pa-splash-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 360px;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center 20%;
  display: block;
}

.pa-splash-overlay {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(5, 9, 18, 0.6) 0%, transparent 50%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--t);
}
.pa-splash-btn:hover .pa-splash-overlay { opacity: 1; }

.pa-splash-hint {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* ================================================================
   CTAs SECTION
   ================================================================ */
.app-cta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.free-badge {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--gray-500);
}

.pa-free-badge { color: #475569; }

/* ================================================================
   SECTION SOUTIEN
   ================================================================ */
.support-section {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #090c18 0%, #101628 50%, #090c18 100%);
  padding: 96px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.support-container { max-width: 540px; }

.support-icons {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.support-icons img { border-radius: 14px; object-fit: cover; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }

.support-plus {
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--gray-500);
}

.support-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.4rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FDA4AF, var(--support));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.support-body {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--gray-300);
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}

.support-note {
  margin-top: 18px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  line-height: 1.9;
}

/* ================================================================
   FOOTER
   ================================================================ */
.footer {
  background: #040508;
  padding: 40px 0 28px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.footer-inner {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  text-align: center;
}

.footer-brand { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--gray-300); }
.footer-brand strong { color: var(--white); }

.footer-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.footer-nav a {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  transition: color var(--t);
}
.footer-nav a:hover { color: var(--white); }

.footer-copy { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #374151; }

/* ================================================================
   LIGHTBOX
   ================================================================ */
.lightbox {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  z-index: 500;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, visibility 0.25s ease;
}

.lightbox.active { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

.lightbox-backdrop {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.93);
  cursor: zoom-out;
}

.lightbox-close {
  position: fixed;
  top: 16px; right: 16px;
  z-index: 510;
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 1rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background var(--t);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.lightbox-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

.lightbox-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 501;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  max-width: 92vw;
  max-height: 90vh;
  animation: lbIn 0.25s ease both;
}

@keyframes lbIn {
  from { transform: scale(0.93); opacity: 0; }
  to   { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}

.lightbox-img {
  max-width: 92vw;
  max-height: 84vh;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}

.lightbox-caption {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  text-align: center;
}

/* ================================================================
   ACCESSIBILITÉ — FOCUS
   ================================================================ */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ap-300);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* ================================================================
   ANIMATIONS SCROLL (reveal)
   ================================================================ */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(28px);
  transition: opacity 0.55s ease, transform 0.55s ease;
}
.reveal.shown {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}
.reveal-d1 { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
.reveal-d2 { transition-delay: 0.16s; }
.reveal-d3 { transition-delay: 0.24s; }
.reveal-d4 { transition-delay: 0.32s; }
.reveal-d5 { transition-delay: 0.40s; }
.reveal-d6 { transition-delay: 0.48s; }

/* ================================================================
   REDUCED MOTION
   ================================================================ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

/* ================================================================
   RESPONSIVE — TABLETTE (≤ 900px)
   ================================================================ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  /* Hero */
  .hero-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
    gap: 32px;
    padding-bottom: 56px;
  }
  .hero-body { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
  .hero-actions { justify-content: center; }
  .hero-visuals { order: -1; height: 260px; }
  .hero-card--ap { width: 140px; height: 252px; left: 15%; }
  .hero-card--pa { width: 210px; height: 130px; right: 8%; }

  /* Nav menu mobile */
  .nav-toggle { display: flex; }
  .nav-menu {
    position: fixed;
    top: 62px; left: 0; right: 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    background: rgba(7, 9, 15, 0.97);
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
    padding: 16px 20px 24px;
    gap: 4px;
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: transform var(--t), opacity var(--t), visibility var(--t);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }
  .nav-menu.open {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: all;
  }
  .nav-link { padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 0.95rem; width: 100%; border-radius: var(--r); }

  /* Fonctionnalités 2 colonnes */
  .features { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

  /* Galerie phone cards */
  .gallery { justify-content: center; }

  /* PA splash */
  .pa-splash-img { height: 280px; }
}

/* ================================================================
   RESPONSIVE — MOBILE (≤ 600px)
   ================================================================ */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  /* Hero */
  .hero-visuals { height: 200px; }
  .hero-card--ap { width: 116px; height: 210px; left: 8%; }
  .hero-card--pa { width: 170px; height: 105px; right: 4%; }
  .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
  .hero-actions .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }

  /* Sections */
  .ap-section, .pa-section { padding: 56px 0 72px; }
  .support-section { padding: 64px 0; }

  /* App header empilé */
  .app-header { flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }

  /* Fonctionnalités 1 colonne */
  .features { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

  /* Galerie portraits */
  .gallery { gap: 14px; justify-content: center; }
  .phone-frame { width: 155px; height: 292px; }

  /* Galerie paysage */
  .game-gallery { max-width: 100%; }

  /* CTAs empilés */
  .app-cta { flex-direction: column; }
  .app-cta .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }

  /* Support */
  .support-icons { gap: 12px; }
  .support-icons img { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .support-section .btn { width: 100%; }

  /* PA splash */
  .pa-splash-img { height: 210px; }
  .pa-splash-btn { border-radius: var(--r-lg); }

  /* Section fade invisible sur mobile */
  .section-fade { height: 60px; }
}

/* ================================================================
   TRÈS PETIT ÉCRAN (≤ 360px)

@media (max-width: 360px) {

}

  <script>/* ================================================================
   NAVIGATION — HEADER STICKY
   ================================================================ */
const header   = document.getElementById('header');
const navToggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
const navMenu   = document.getElementById('navMenu');

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  header.classList.toggle('solid', window.scrollY > 30);
}, { passive: true });

navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const open = navMenu.classList.toggle('open');
  navToggle.classList.toggle('open', open);
  navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
});

/* Fermer le menu en cliquant un lien */
navMenu.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => {
  link.addEventListener('click', () => {
    navMenu.classList.remove('open');
    navToggle.classList.remove('open');
    navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  });
});

/* Fermer en cliquant en dehors */
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (!header.contains(e.target)) {
    navMenu.classList.remove('open');
    navToggle.classList.remove('open');
  }
}, { passive: true });

/* ================================================================
   ÉTOILES DANS LE HERO
   ================================================================ */
(function spawnStars() {
  const container = document.getElementById('heroStars');
  if (!container) return;

  const count = window.innerWidth < 600 ? 55 : 110;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const s = document.createElement('div');
    s.className = 'star';
    const size = Math.random() < 0.15 ? 3 : Math.random() < 0.5 ? 2 : 1;
    s.style.cssText = [
      `width:${size}px`,
      `height:${size}px`,
      `left:${(Math.random() * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
      `top:${(Math.random() * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
      `--dur:${(2.5 + Math.random() * 4).toFixed(2)}s`,
      `--delay:${(Math.random() * 5).toFixed(2)}s`,
      `opacity:${(Math.random() * 0.6 + 0.1).toFixed(2)}`
    ].join(';');
    container.appendChild(s);
  }

  /* quelques "pixels" colorés façon PA */
  const colors = ['rgba(59,111,228,0.7)', 'rgba(245,158,11,0.6)', 'rgba(34,197,94,0.5)', 'rgba(124,58,237,0.5)'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'star';
    const side = (Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + 1) * 3; /* 3 ou 6 px */
    p.style.cssText = [
      `width:${side}px`,
      `height:${side}px`,
      `border-radius:1px`,
      `background:${colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)]}`,
      `left:${(Math.random() * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
      `top:${(Math.random() * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
      `--dur:${(3 + Math.random() * 5).toFixed(2)}s`,
      `--delay:${(Math.random() * 6).toFixed(2)}s`,
      `opacity:0.4`
    ].join(';');
    container.appendChild(p);
  }
})();

/* ================================================================
   SCROLL REVEAL
   ================================================================ */
const revealObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('shown');
      revealObs.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -32px 0px' });

/* Ajouter la classe reveal + délais aux éléments cibles */
function attachReveal() {
  /* En-têtes de section */
  document.querySelectorAll('.app-header, .app-desc').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.add('reveal');
    revealObs.observe(el);
  });

  /* Cartes de fonctionnalités */
  document.querySelectorAll('.feat').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.classList.add('reveal', `reveal-d${(i % 6) + 1}`);
    revealObs.observe(el);
  });

  /* Galeries */
  document.querySelectorAll('.phone-card, .game-card').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.classList.add('reveal', `reveal-d${(i % 3) + 1}`);
    revealObs.observe(el);
  });

  /* CTAs */
  document.querySelectorAll('.app-cta, .free-badge, .gallery-heading, .pa-splash-btn').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.add('reveal');
    revealObs.observe(el);
  });

  /* Section support */
  document.querySelectorAll('.support-icons, .support-title, .support-body, .support-section .btn, .support-note').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.classList.add('reveal', `reveal-d${i + 1}`);
    revealObs.observe(el);
  });
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', attachReveal);
} else {
  attachReveal();
}

/* ================================================================
   LIGHTBOX
   ================================================================ */
const lightbox        = document.getElementById('lightbox');
const lightboxImg     = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
const lightboxCaption = document.getElementById('lightboxCaption');

function openLightbox(src, caption) {
  lightboxImg.src = src;
  lightboxImg.alt = caption || '';
  lightboxCaption.textContent = caption || '';
  lightbox.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  lightbox.querySelector('.lightbox-close').focus();
}

function closeLightbox() {
  lightbox.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
  setTimeout(() => { lightboxImg.src = ''; }, 300);
}

/* Fermer avec Echap */
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && lightbox.classList.contains('active')) closeLightbox();
});

/* Swipe bas pour fermer sur mobile */
let touchY0 = 0;
lightbox.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { touchY0 = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
lightbox.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
  if (Math.abs(e.changedTouches[0].clientY - touchY0) > 70) closeLightbox();
}, { passive: true });

/* Rendre openLightbox / closeLightbox accessibles globalement (appelés depuis le HTML) */
window.openLightbox  = openLightbox;
window.closeLightbox = closeLightbox;

/* ================================================================
   SMOOTH SCROLL — ancres internes
   ================================================================ */
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
  a.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const target = document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
    if (!target) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const offset = header.offsetHeight + 8;
    window.scrollTo({ top: target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - offset, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
